findings.title: Unusual behaviour in nng_repro_fixed[16]
findings.summary: nng_repro_fixed[16] (prio 10) behaved unlike healthy QNX programs in 46 of its 46 time windows; the most unusual stretch lasted 920 ms. It stands out in: time waiting on a condition variable (higher than healthy), longest single block (higher than healthy), CPU migrations (higher than healthy). The closest pattern TraceLens has seen is priority inversion while waiting on a condition variable, but only loosely (distance 10.0 against 0.847 typical for it): treat this as behaviour of its own.
findings.qnx_note: Learned from healthy QNX 8.0 traces: this thread behaved unlike any healthy run in the features listed. It is not a proven bug and gets no automatic fix: look at the timeline around it. Any resemblance to a known pattern is measured against labelled example windows, never a rule that fired.
